page.overview:
What is Infinity Stones?

The Infinity Stones (formerly known as the Infinity Gems and the Soul Gems) are powerful artifacts that originated from the remnant of the First Firmament, the original universe, found below the Quarry of Creation and inhabited by Celestials, known as the First Celestials. That universe contains countless Infinity Stones, which get sent to other universes by the Celestials.

According to one account, the Infinity Gems came about from the cosmic suicide of Nemesis, although a later account reframed this to be just a dream.

The Soul Stone came into the possession of the High Evolutionary, who gifted it to Adam Warlock. The Mind Stone was discovered buried beneath the planet Deneb IV by the Supreme Intelligence. The Time Stone was used by the Gardener, while the Power Stone was found by the Stranger. The Space Stone and Reality Stone were both stolen by Thanos - one from a prison satellite, and the other from a powerful being called Xiambor.

Thanos was eventually able to steal all but the Soul Stone, but through posing as an ally to Warlock against the Magus, he was able to siphon enough energy from it to build a giant artificial Soul Stone, which he used to contain the others. He intended to destroy the universe by using the gems to destroy the stars. He was stopped by the Avengers, Adam Warlock and Captain Marvel.

Also known as: Infinity Gems.
